author: dreambig5
body:
Turn it down if Anguish if A1 is hard (I'm guessing you're using the old system so maybe read about the new system because there you can have control over where you want Anguish to take effect). I don't think you get any anguished gear/weapons if you're on the old anguish system. 

Once you get to T9-T10, I'd play with atleast A1 just to get proofs. It's obviously most beneficial for T11 because you've completed the "tutorial" and are just looking to increase the level of challenge.

It's easier from T10/T11 because you get access to ascension levels (so you can increase your stats which allow you to take on higher anguish levels).
